hazards.explanation: Scans ahead down the travel lane to notice hazard flashers; checks rear/side mirrors early to evaluate passing room.
hazards.avHandling: LiDAR/Camera perception detects stationary obstacle in travel path, recalculates free-space vector, generates lane-change trajectory, and verifies clear clearance zone via 360-degree radar.

hazards.explanation: Monitors curb lines and movement intent; looks for head orientation and gait indicating crossing behavior.
hazards.avHandling: Pedestrian classification pipeline assigns bounding box, tracks velocity vector, and predicts cross-path probability; triggers smooth automatic deceleration until path clears.

hazards.explanation: Scans incoming vehicles at all-way stop; identifies non-slowing wheel rotation on cross-street driver indicating intent to run the stop sign.
hazards.avHandling: Multi-agent behavioral forecasting tracks cross-street vehicle deceleration rates; detects stop-line roll-through and suppresses ego-vehicle movement command until intersection conflicts clear.

hazards.explanation: Reads roadside warning signs and identifies pavement surface elevation changes well ahead.
hazards.avHandling: HD Map overlays provide micro-geometry data for speed bumps; cameras/LiDAR detect vertical profile changes and adjust suspension/target velocity automatically.

hazards.explanation: Leans forward in seat to peek past A-pillars and parked vehicles to evaluate oncoming cross-street traffic gaps.
hazards.avHandling: Executes virtual 'creep motion'; uses forward fender/side-mounted wide-angle cameras and long-range radar to see past occlusion zones before issuing go-command.

hazards.explanation: Maintains continuous visual lock on pedestrian; waits for step off travel lane onto sidewalk before accelerating.
hazards.avHandling: Perception system maintains active tracking anchor on dynamic pedestrian bounding box; vehicle motion planner holds stop point until safe buffer distance is restored.

hazards.explanation: Performs head checks across shoulders and checks side/rear mirrors repeatedly to avoid curb or bumper contact.
hazards.avHandling: Surround-view cameras and ultrasonic proximity sensors map curb boundary and nearby bumpers; automated parking planner executes exact steering and gear shifts.
